text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: 16 tests, all OK. I didn't modify the tests. The fixes in `catalog/`:

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`, so I pointed the import at `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it with `int`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the policy comment and tests say 5, so I set it to 5.
- **`fees.py`:** the late fee added the daily rate (`+`) instead of multiplying (`*`).
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n+1` events because of an off-by-one slice. I also made `recent(0)` return an empty list. That edge case wasn't in the tests, and without the guard `[-0:]` would return the whole history.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing the `Emma` book, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`.
